question: Does the complete exact-current-main Dimmed-producer to later-Attack repertoire have enough broad, inactive, viable and separately identifiable natural capacity to justify one identity-only preflight of a Dimmed-target extra-Facet primitive?
registrationStatus: Frozen before the first calculation of the Dimmed-producer to later-Attack support predicate. Candidate construction uses exact source and prior immutable family decisions only. The first deterministic invocation stopped before loading the trace because one play_card chip-resolution sentinel was incorrectly scoped to hit_enemy. This corrected registration changes only that source-assertion scope and the runner hash; no support, endpoint, factor, class, primitive, anchor, gate, cohort, budget or disposition was read or changed.

scientificBasis.existingGrammarExhaustion: The exact native Dusk grammar and direct Ember-consumer audits exhausted shipped mechanisms, Hearth is quarantined, and the complete source-derived multi-hit alias fracture has just failed its frozen inactivity gate. Issue #421 therefore authorises the smallest materially different deterministic primitive rather than another scalar or historical-family rerun.
scientificBasis.measuredRepertoire: Exact content has three normal-and-upgraded cards that apply Dimmed to enemies. The frozen policy model has a sampled Weak preference, and prior immutable evidence observed all three producers in natural temporal pairs. Those facts establish a policy-sensitive authored repertoire; they do not establish this new consumer or its support.
scientificBasis.missingCoupling: Current player Attack damage reads player Dimmed and target Cracked, while current implicit Facet arithmetic reads Attack hit, authored chip and Beacon. Neither the runtime hit path nor preview path reads target Dimmed for Facet progress. The new primitive links an existing defensive status to the Dusk core resource without changing Dimmed duration or damage.
scientificBasis.necessaryCapacity: A row can respond only if a complete-class Dimmed producer is played before a later complete-class Attack in the same fight. This is a permissive upper bound: it does not prove shared target, status persistence, legal choice, unblocked damage, target survival, extra chip, Shatter or endpoint movement.

candidate.primitive: For Duskblade only, when an Attack draws unblocked blood from a target that is already Dimmed at hit time, mark exactly one additional implicit Facet chip for that target and card. The bonus lands through the existing post-card pending-chip and living-target rules, at most once per target and card.
candidate.previewContract: The pure play preview adds the same one chip only when the selected living target is already Dimmed, the Attack has positive projected unblocked loss and the play is non-lethal under the existing preview boundary.
candidate.unchanged: Dimmed amount and duration, enemy damage reduction, Attack damage, target selection, authored chip, explicit chip effects, Beacon, multi-hit cardinality, killed-target handling, Facet threshold, Shatter outputs, content, acquisition, policy identities, RNG and every other aspect remain unchanged.

currentHitSentinels: var n: int = (per if hit_flag else 0) + extra
sourceAssertions.absenceRule: Exact hit_enemy and preview_play/_preview_hit source contain no target/enemy Weak read. This proves only the missing coupling in current source, not candidate value.

trace.selectionRule: Read the complete immutable 64-policy by four-seed capture trace once. Its legacy qualified-harness scope is disclosed; this audit makes only a deterministic necessary play-order capacity claim. Any new runtime observation requires the exact #456-qualified 4.7.2 binary and fresh identities.

cohort.identity: The same complete frozen policy and seed rectangle supplies candidate opportunity, viability, both anchors and reliability.

definitions.opportunityRow: Within one fight, a complete-class enemy-Dimmed producer is played before a later complete-class Attack.
definitions.potentialActivePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows contain an opportunity.
definitions.exactInactivePolicy: None of four frozen rows contains an opportunity.
definitions.viablePolicy: A potential-active policy has at least one opportunity row whose whole-run outcome is win.
definitions.sourceBreadth: The complete trace must witness at least two distinct producer cards, four distinct later Attack cards and eight distinct ordered producer-consumer pairs. No witnessed subset replaces either complete source class.

design.type: zero-row necessary-condition capacity audit; not a factorial, causal contrast or optimiser
design.sharedIdentity: All blocks reuse the identical baseline, policies, seeds, whole-run cohort, estimator and stop rule.
design.noCartesianExpansion: No factor varies and no joint cell exists. The same cached rows are read once.

dimmedFacetPrimitive.status: Fixed here; conditional levels receive direct-control and null-identity authority only if every capacity gate passes.

scorelinePayoff.status: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied, bundled or estimated.

afterimagePayoff.status: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied, bundled or estimated.

acquisitionPriority.status: Fixed; no acquisition intervention is used.

scoreline.definition: A robust policy has positive Chisel-play and Executioner-play counts in the same whole run in at least two of four rows.
scoreline.status: Separate permissive overlap anchor only; no order, shared target, Scoreline payoff or interaction is inferred.

afterimage.definition: A robust policy has positive Defend-play and Guarded Strike-play counts in the same whole run in at least two of four rows.
afterimage.status: Separate permissive overlap anchor only; no simultaneous Ward state, Afterimage payoff or interaction is inferred.

interactionsAndAliases.mechanisticInteraction: The only proposed interaction is pre-existing target Dimmed by a later connecting Dusk Attack. Dimmed's existing enemy-damage reduction remains fixed and is not credited to the primitive.
interactionsAndAliases.notEstimated: No causal interaction or payoff is estimated. Candidate-only, anchor-only and Jaccard statistics are necessary decision-value screens against Scoreline and Afterimage separately.
interactionsAndAliases.temporalTargetAlias: Play order lacks shared target, status persistence, damage, survival and chip state. Every missing field can overstate opportunity, so failure is decisive and success authorises identity-safe telemetry only.
interactionsAndAliases.closedFamilyBoundary: This target-status-to-Facet transducer is not weak-mend persistence, voluntary-loss recovery, recovery-repeated-hit, Cracked execute, generic Weak tuning, multi-hit cardinality, reward overchip, Scoreline, Afterimage, Ward, Kindle, Hearth, action economy or acquisition priority.
interactionsAndAliases.noAdaptation: All three producers and every later Attack remain eligible in the opportunity upper bound. Do not select a producer, consumer, target type, rarity, threshold or observed policy subgroup after this look.

estimands.primary: Exact robust potential-active, exact-inactive, ambiguous and viable policy counts and identities under the complete play-order upper bound.
estimands.sourceBreadth: Exact distinct witnessed producer cards, later Attack cards and ordered pairs.
estimands.separation: Candidate-only, anchor-only, cross-active and Jaccard counts against Scoreline and Afterimage separately.
estimands.reliability: Exact stall or error row count.
estimands.notEstimated: No target Weak state, shared target, hit, target survival, extra chip, Shatter, damage prevention, causal effect, detector, duration, product balance or protected endpoint is estimated.

gates.provenance: The 16-policy support and inactivity minima, eight-policy viability and two-sided separation minima, 0.55 overlap ceiling and one-fault ceiling are the frozen 64-policy scale. Breadth extends the already-used two-producer/four-pair minimum to four later Attacks and eight pairs because the complete consumer class is substantially larger.

factorDisposition.candidate: No candidate is implemented, simulated or promoted here.
factorDisposition.scorelineAndAfterimage: Scoreline payoff and Afterimage payoff remain separate fixed causal factors and separate overlap anchors.
factorDisposition.closedFamilies: No Weak-mend, recovery, multi-hit, Cracked, reward-overchip, Ward, Kindle, Hearth, action-economy or acquisition closure is reopened.
factorDisposition.additionalMethod: No ML, RL, optimiser, fitted model or new policy mapping is used or authorised. Existing sampled Weak preference is immutable policy identity, not a new method.
factorDisposition.protectedSeeds: Acceptance seeds 3000-5199 and reserve seeds 5200-5399 remain unused.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python verifies exact source, derives both complete card classes, proves the missing current target-Dimmed coupling, validates trace and ledger identity, evaluates every frozen gate once and owns stop/go.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: The complete cached rectangle is the sole look. No simulator, repair, threshold change, card subset, primitive level or rerun exists.
executionAndStopping.successStop: Stop only if every support, inactivity, viability, breadth, separation and reliability gate passes.
executionAndStopping.futilityStop: Stop when any gate fails and close the complete target-Dimmed extra-Facet family without implementation or a narrower variant.
executionAndStopping.inconclusiveStop: Record inconclusive at the 30-second cap if the completed deterministic decision is unavailable.

decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze only the exact one-chip target-Dimmed primitive for one separately preregistered exact-4.7.2 identity preflight. Direct controls must prove no-Weak, blocked, lethal, dead, Ashwarden, authored-chip, explicit-chip, Beacon and multi-hit isolation; omitted and explicit false must reproduce pristine path, RNG, policy and result exactly. No enabled whole-run or causal row is authorised.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and close the complete target-Dimmed extra-Facet primitive family. Do not select producers or Attacks, change the one-chip value, add a carrier, alter Weak, add acquisition priority, implement or rerun it. Continue issue #421 with the next materially different evidence-backed structural mechanism.
decisionRules.inconclusive: The completed deterministic decision is unavailable at the cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record this family inconclusive at the cap without implementation, simulation, repair, a new method or protected seeds.

weakSourceBreadthOnly.boundary: Only the exact three-card Weak producer inventory and its sampled source breadth are reused. Weak-mend endpoints and implementation authority are not reused.
